name: SUVAT — Final Velocity (v = u + at)
definition: Final velocity after constant acceleration a for time t.

name: SUVAT — Displacement (s = ut + ½at²)
definition: Displacement under uniform acceleration from initial velocity u.

name: SUVAT — Velocity-Displacement (v² = u² + 2as)
definition: Final speed from initial speed, acceleration, and displacement without time.

name: SUVAT — Average Velocity Displacement
definition: Displacement using mean of initial and final velocity.

name: Projectile Horizontal Range
definition: Horizontal range of a projectile launched at angle θ on level ground.

name: Projectile Maximum Height
definition: Peak vertical height reached by a projectile.

name: Newton's Second Law (F = ma)
definition: Resultant force equals mass multiplied by acceleration.

name: Linear Momentum & Impulse
definition: Linear momentum of a mass m moving at velocity v.

name: Kinetic / Static Friction Force
definition: Friction force from coefficient of friction μ and normal reaction N.

name: Moment / Torque of a Force
definition: Turning effect (torque) of force F applied at distance r and angle θ.

name: Hooke's Law & Elastic Potential Energy
definition: Elastic strain energy stored in a spring of stiffness k extended by x.

name: Young's Modulus (Stress / Strain)
definition: Tensile stiffness E of an elastic wire/rod.

name: Hydrostatic Fluid Pressure
definition: Gauge pressure at depth h in a fluid of density ρ.

name: Mechanical Work Done
definition: Work transferred by force F acting over displacement d at angle θ.

name: Kinetic Energy (½mv²)
definition: Translational kinetic energy of mass m moving at speed v.

name: Gravitational Potential Energy (mgh)
definition: Potential energy near Earth's surface at height h.

name: Mechanical Power (P = Fv)
definition: Instantaneous mechanical power delivered by force F at velocity v.

name: Centripetal Force (mv²/r)
definition: Net inward radial force maintaining circular motion of radius r.

name: Newton's Law of Universal Gravitation
definition: Gravitational attraction between point masses m1 and m2 (G = 6.6743e-11).

name: Circular Orbital Speed
definition: Speed of a satellite in circular orbit of radius r around mass M.

name: Escape Velocity
definition: Minimum launch speed to escape a body of mass M and radius R.

name: Simple Pendulum Period
definition: Small-angle oscillation period of a simple pendulum of length L.

name: Mass-Spring Oscillator Period
definition: Oscillation period of mass m attached to a spring of constant k.

name: SHM Maximum Speed
definition: Maximum velocity at equilibrium in simple harmonic motion.

name: Wave Speed (v = fλ)
definition: Universal wave equation linking speed, frequency, and wavelength.

name: Young's Double-Slit Fringe Spacing
definition: Fringe separation on a screen at distance D from slits separated by d.

name: Doppler Effect (Moving Source)
definition: Observed frequency when a source approaches at speed v_s (negative if receding).

name: Specific Heat Capacity (Q = mcΔT)
definition: Heat required to raise temperature of mass m by ΔT.

name: Stefan-Boltzmann Radiation Power
definition: Thermal power radiated by a surface of emissivity e, area A, and Kelvin temp T.

name: Wien's Displacement Law
definition: Peak emission wavelength of a blackbody at temperature T (K).

name: Carnot Heat Engine Efficiency
definition: Maximum theoretical efficiency between cold reservoir T_C and hot reservoir T_H (K).

name: Coulomb's Law (Electrostatic Force)
definition: Force between two point charges in vacuum.

name: Wire Resistance from Resistivity
definition: Electrical resistance of a conductor of resistivity ρ, length L, and area A.

name: Energy Stored in a Capacitor
definition: Electrostatic energy stored in capacitance C charged to voltage V.

name: Magnetic Force on Current-Carrying Wire
definition: Force on wire of length L carrying current I in magnetic field B.

name: Magnetic Force on Moving Charge
definition: Lorentz magnetic force on charge q moving at speed v in field B.

name: Thin Lens Focal Length
definition: Focal length from object distance u and image distance v.

name: Snell's Law — Refracted Angle
definition: Angle of refraction in medium n2 for incidence angle θ1 in medium n1.

name: Photon Energy (E = hc/λ)
definition: Energy of a photon with wavelength λ (h = 6.626e-34, c = 3e8).

name: de Broglie Matter Wavelength
definition: Matter wavelength of a particle with mass m and speed v.

name: Radioactive Decay Law (N = N₀e^(-λt))
definition: Remaining undecayed nuclei after time t with decay constant λ.

name: Radioactive Half-Life
definition: Time for half of radioactive nuclei to decay.

name: Mass-Energy Equivalence (E = mc²)
definition: Energy released from mass defect Δm (c = 2.998e8 m/s).

name: Moles from Mass (n = m / M)
definition: Amount of substance in moles from sample mass m and molar mass M.

name: Moles from Solution Concentration (n = CV)
definition: Moles of solute from concentration C (mol/dm³) and volume V (dm³).

name: Dilution Formula (C₁V₁ = C₂V₂)
definition: Final concentration after diluting solution from V1 to V2.

name: Percentage Yield
definition: Efficiency of a chemical synthesis compared to theoretical maximum.

name: Ideal Gas Law — Pressure (PV = nRT)
definition: Ideal gas pressure in Pascals (R = 8.31446 J/(mol·K), V in m³, T in K).

name: Boyle's Law (P₁V₁ = P₂V₂)
definition: New gas pressure at constant temperature when volume changes from V1 to V2.

name: Combined Gas Law
definition: Final volume of a fixed amount of gas undergoing P and T changes.

name: Enthalpy Change per Mole (Calorimetry)
definition: Molar enthalpy change in kJ/mol from solution calorimetry.

name: Gibbs Free Energy (ΔG = ΔH - TΔS)
definition: Spontaneity criterion in kJ/mol (ΔH in kJ/mol, ΔS in J/(mol·K)).

name: Gibbs Free Energy from Equilibrium Constant
definition: Standard Gibbs energy (kJ/mol) from equilibrium constant K.

name: Arrhenius Rate Constant
definition: Rate constant k from frequency factor A and activation energy Ea (J/mol).

name: Kp from Kc Relationship
definition: Relates pressure and concentration equilibrium constants (R = 0.08206 L·atm/(mol·K)).

name: Beer-Lambert Law (Absorbance)
definition: Optical absorbance from molar absorptivity ε, path length l, and concentration c.

name: pH from [H⁺] Concentration
definition: Acidity scale from hydrogen ion molarity.

name: Weak Acid pH Approximation
definition: pH of a monoprotic weak acid of dissociation constant Ka and concentration C.

name: Henderson-Hasselbalch Buffer pH
definition: pH of an acidic buffer solution.

name: Nernst Equation (298 K)
definition: Cell potential at 298 K from standard potential E°, electrons n, and reaction quotient Q.

name: Faraday's Law of Electrolysis
definition: Mass deposited during electrolysis (F = 96485 C/mol).

name: Quadratic Formula (Positive Root)
definition: Positive root of ax² + bx + c = 0.

name: Quadratic Discriminant (Δ = b² - 4ac)
definition: Determines nature of quadratic roots (>0 two real, =0 repeated, <0 complex).

name: 2D Euclidean Distance
definition: Straight-line distance between points (x1, y1) and (x2, y2).

name: Logarithm Change of Base
definition: Evaluates logarithm of x to any positive base b ≠ 1.

name: Compound Interest / Exponential Growth
definition: Accumulated amount for principal P, annual rate r (decimal), n periods/year, t years.

name: Circular Sector Area (Radians)
definition: Area of a circular sector of radius r and central angle θ (radians).

name: Volume of a Sphere
definition: Volume enclosed by a sphere of radius r.

name: Law of Cosines (Side Length)
definition: Third side of any triangle from sides a, b and included angle C (deg).
calcExpr: sqrt(a^2 + b^2 - 2 * a * b * cos(C deg))

name: Triangle Area (½ab sin C)
definition: Area of a triangle from two sides and their included angle.

name: Arithmetic Series Sum (Sₙ)
definition: Sum of first n terms of an arithmetic progression.

name: Geometric Series Sum (Sₙ)
definition: Sum of first n terms of a geometric progression (r ≠ 1).

name: Geometric Sum to Infinity (|r| < 1)
definition: Convergent infinite geometric series sum for |r| < 1.

name: 3D Vector Dot Product
definition: Scalar (dot) product of two 3D vectors.
calcExpr: ax * bx + ay * by + az * bz

name: 2×2 Matrix Determinant
definition: Determinant of a 2×2 matrix [[a, b], [c, d]].

name: Definite Integral of Power Function (∫ xⁿ dx)
definition: Exact definite integral of xⁿ from a to b (n ≠ -1).

name: Binomial Probability P(X = k)
definition: Exact probability of k successes in n Bernoulli trials.

name: Poisson Probability P(X = k)
definition: Probability of k rare events occurring in an interval with mean rate λ.

name: Standard Normal Z-Score
definition: Number of standard deviations x lies from the mean μ.

name: Bayes' Theorem
definition: Posterior probability of A given observed event B.

name: Ohm's Law (V = IR)
definition: Voltage drop across a linear resistor R carrying current I.

name: DC Electrical Power (P = I²R)
definition: Joule heating power dissipated in resistor R.

name: Resistive Voltage Divider
definition: Output voltage across R2 in a series divider.

name: Current Divider Rule
definition: Branch current through R1 in a two-resistor parallel network.

name: Parallel Equivalent Resistance
definition: Combined resistance of two resistors in parallel.

name: RC Charging Voltage & Time Constant
definition: Capacitor voltage charging through resistor R from step source V0.

name: RL Time Constant (τ = L/R)
definition: Characteristic transient time constant of a first-order RL circuit.

name: Inductive Reactance (XL = 2πfL)
definition: Sinusoidal AC reactance of an ideal inductor L.

name: Capacitive Reactance (XC = 1 / 2πfC)
definition: Sinusoidal AC reactance of an ideal capacitor C.

name: Series RLC Impedance Magnitude
definition: Magnitude of total series RLC complex impedance.

name: Sinusoidal RMS Voltage
definition: Root-mean-square value of a pure sine wave with peak amplitude Vm.

name: RLC Resonant Frequency (f₀)
definition: Frequency where XL = XC in an LC or RLC network.

name: RC Filter Cutoff Frequency (-3 dB)
definition: Corner frequency of a basic 1st-order RC low-pass or high-pass filter.

name: LED Current-Limiting Resistor
definition: Series resistor required to safely drive an LED from supply Vs.

name: Inverting Op-Amp Voltage Gain
definition: Closed-loop voltage gain of an ideal inverting op-amp.

name: Non-Inverting Op-Amp Voltage Gain
definition: Closed-loop voltage gain of an ideal non-inverting op-amp.

name: BJT Collector Current (I_C = β I_B)
definition: Active-region BJT collector current from DC current gain β and base current.

name: Voltage Gain in Decibels (dB)
definition: Logarithmic voltage gain in dB.

name: Balanced 3-Phase Real Power
definition: Total real power in a balanced three-phase Y or Δ load.

name: Ideal Transformer Secondary Voltage
definition: Secondary voltage from primary voltage and turns ratio.

name: AC Motor Synchronous Speed
definition: Synchronous stator field speed in RPM for P poles at frequency f.

name: Induction Motor Slip (%)
definition: Percentage slip between synchronous speed ns and rotor speed nr.

name: n-Bit Binary State Count
definition: Number of unique states representable with n binary bits.

name: ADC Quantization Step (LSB Voltage)
definition: Smallest voltage step resolved by an n-bit ADC with reference Vref.

name: Nyquist Minimum Sampling Rate
definition: Minimum sampling frequency to avoid aliasing.

name: Shannon-Hartley Channel Capacity
definition: Maximum error-free data rate (bits/s) over a channel of bandwidth B and linear SNR.

name: EM Wavelength in Dielectric Medium
definition: Wavelength of an EM wave of frequency f in medium of relative permittivity εr.

name: 2nd-Order Control System Damping Ratio
definition: Damping ratio ζ for characteristic polynomial a·s² + b·s + c = 0.
